article.title: Ads Uploader為Meta廣告代理加入可配置審批
article.summary: 第三方工具Ads Uploader推出Agent Inbox。設為Approval的操作，須由人員批准才會送往Meta。
highlights: 發布及修改權限可按廣告帳戶分開設定。
審批畫面顯示原值、新值和理由，支援部分批准及操作紀錄。
article.why: 代理商可為新廣告及在投素材設不同權限，以配合各客戶的審批制度。
article.next_step: 挑一個測試帳戶，分別核對發布和修改的權限，並驗證部分批准的紀錄。
article.detail: Ads Uploader表示Agent Inbox接收透過其MCP提出的Meta廣告發布及修改建議。團隊可按廣告帳戶分開設置發布與修改權限，使用Approval時才會暫停操作並等待人手批准。審批人員可看原值、新值和理由，選擇批准部分修改，系統會記錄操作。
article.title_en: Ads Uploader adds configurable review for Meta ad agents
article.summary_en: Third-party tool Ads Uploader introduced Agent Inbox. Actions set to Approval require a reviewer before they reach Meta.
highlights_en: Launch and edit permissions can be set independently per ad account.
Reviewers see old and proposed values and reasons, can approve selected changes and have an action log.
article.why_en: Agencies can set different permissions for new ads and live creative to fit each client's review policy.
article.next_step_en: In a test account, check launch and edit permissions separately and verify the log after partial approval.
article.detail_en: Ads Uploader says Agent Inbox receives Meta ad launch and edit proposals made through its MCP. Teams set launch and edit permissions independently by ad account. Approval mode pauses actions for human review. Reviewers see current values, proposals and reasons, can approve selected changes, and have a record of actions.
